terminalAdjustment: Each case is isolated in a document with zero root margins. Fixed-point fragment offsets replace getBoundingClientRect; graphical backgrounds and the browser test harness are unnecessary.

excludedCases.reason: Intrinsic block-size keywords fit-content, max-content, and min-content are outside the supported height policy. They must not be counted as conformance merely because an unsupported declaration falls back to auto.
The stretch height keyword is not supported; grid/flex stretching is separately covered and does not imply support for height:stretch.
